claim: For all coprime integers \(p,q>1\) and every integer \(s>1\) with \(\gcd(s,pq)=1\), the torus-knot group \(G_{p,q}=\langle a,b\mid a^p=b^q\rangle\) embeds in \(G_{pq,s}=\langle x,y\mid x^{pq}=y^s\rangle\) via \(a\mapsto x^q\) and \(b\mapsto yx^p y^{-1}\); the groups are nonisomorphic because their quotients by their infinite cyclic centers are \(C_p*C_q\) and \(C_{pq}*C_s\), respectively.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof; all claimed implications are proved in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Exact presentation check, reduced-word normal form in free products, and an explicit homomorphism to the integers showing the target central element has infinite order.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Sufficient family of injective homomorphisms between torus-knot groups; no classification of all embeddings.
unproved_limits: No classification of embeddings for arbitrary parameter pairs.
No exhaustive search of all subgroup-classification literature.

title: A composite-exponent embedding family for torus knot groups
